notes.title: Important update of the demo version of the game
notes.content:
Attention, attention, attention! Gertruder! Achtung! 

At Count Dracula's behest, our tame -- and undead -- gnomes have risen from their little coffins and conjured up a new demo version of After Shadows. We don't have enough pony skins to describe all the changes (we don't use paper, preferring all natural and beautiful), so we'll make only theses remarks:

* The demo version fully supports the controller. You no longer have to break your fingers on the keyboard, trying to hit the right button. 

* The dark monster has become more charismatic and dangerous, like Hannibal Lecter. He's not so easy to get away from anymore. Yum, yum, yum...

* Improved HUD interface. Now you know exactly where to look and what to do.

* Completely fixed the operation of the ropes. No more swinging like a fool and jumping past.

* Fixed bugs in training. From now on, you won't accidentally sell your soul to Satan!

*Visual is now as beautiful as the Mona Lisa. Only without Mona. And the Lisa. And it has nothing to do with anything!

* And lots of other things.

Turn on the demo and enjoy the innovations. Otherwise, our tame, undead gnomes will be put to rest forever in the nearest tree!
